'''challenger QMC w/ The Vane (V)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[challenger]]
* '''Published:''' 16 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay)]]
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Cloud City East Platform (Docking QMCwTheV.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Just trying out an evasive QMC w/o having to ditch YISYW for HoTJ.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Get your sites, flip turn 2, hold Bespin firm (shouldn’t be difficult) for Menace Fades, Celebration, and Battle Plan. Dance around a little on the ground, and smack your opponent when the time is right. It should be fairly difficult for your opponent to damage you between your retrieval (Flash (V), Celebration, OTE), damage reduction (Menace Fades, Atrocity (V), Endor Celeb), and just plain fighting him so he doesn’t get much of a chance. It’s QMC: Take him out.
